description: Header file defining the SymBool class, which represents symbolic boolean values with various logical operations, guards, and conversions within the c10 namespace, used in PyTorch's symbolic computation framework.

classes.name: SymBool
classes.description: Represents a symbolic boolean value with logical operations, guards, and conversion methods.

methods.name: SymBool(bool b)
methods.description: Constructor initializing SymBool with a boolean value.

methods.name: SymBool(SymNode ptr)
methods.description: Constructor initializing SymBool with a SymNode, checks if node is boolean.

methods.name: toSymNodeImpl
methods.description: Returns a SymNode, valid if heap allocated.

methods.name: wrap_node
methods.description: Wraps the SymNode with a base node if necessary.

methods.name: expect_bool
methods.description: Returns the boolean value, checks if it is available.

methods.name: guard_bool
methods.description: Guards the boolean value, returns it.

methods.name: expect_true
methods.description: Checks if the boolean is true.

methods.name: statically_known_true
methods.description: Checks if the boolean is statically true.

methods.name: has_hint
methods.description: Indicates if a hint is available.

methods.name: as_bool_unchecked
methods.description: Returns the boolean value without checks.

methods.name: is_heap_allocated
methods.description: Checks if the SymBool is heap allocated.
